prompt:
The image shows one rectangular tile board with 7 rows and 7 columns. Row labels are on the left and column labels are on the top. One brown [#887044] tile appears in every column. After every such tile drops straight down until it reaches a black [#000000] tile or the board bottom, what is the greatest drop distance?
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence format: set "evidence" to the ordered [row, col] path of the uniquely farthest-falling tile from its start cell to its final cell.
Answer requirement: set "answer" to the maximum downward drop distance in cells as an integer.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[0,1],[1,1],[2,1]],"answer":2}
